tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Remax AA02 3071mWh USB Type-C Rechargeable Lithium Battery is a high-performance power solution designed to replace traditional disposable AA batteries. Built with advanced lithium technology, this battery provides a stable 1.5V output and reliable performance for a wide range of electronic devices including wireless keyboards, cameras, gaming controllers, flashlights, toys, and smart home gadgets.


With its built-in USB Type-C charging port, the Remax AA02 battery can be easily recharged using a USB cable from a laptop, power bank, or wall charger. This eliminates the need for a separate battery charger and offers convenient charging anytime, anywhere.

Featuring a large 3071mWh capacity, the battery delivers long-lasting power and consistent performance compared to standard alkaline batteries. It supports multiple recharge cycles, making it a cost-effective and eco-friendly alternative for everyday use.

The standard AA-size design ensures compatibility with most devices that require AA batteries, while the durable construction provides safe and stable power delivery.

Buy the Remax AA02 USB-C Rechargeable Lithium AA Battery from D CORE and enjoy reliable, rechargeable power for your everyday electronics.


Key Features

  • USB Type-C rechargeable AA lithium battery
  • Large 3071mWh capacity for long runtime
  • Stable 1.5V output for consistent device performance
  • Direct USB charging – no separate charger needed
  • Fast and convenient charging with USB-C cable
  • Rechargeable and eco-friendly design
  • Long lifecycle with multiple charge cycles
  • Compatible with cameras, remotes, toys, flashlights, and wireless devices
